feedback.delta: Route to CC-WP-03/04/07/09: semantic resources crossing FFI should use opaque/generative identity plus explicit own/borrow and current authority validation at effect time. Raw host handles and static effect summaries are not bearer authority. No new surface syntax is justified yet.

Add differential fixtures for revoke/regrant during delayed/recurrent effects, ownership transfer, cancellation/retry, raw fd reuse, FFI/subprocess escape and stale-borrow rejection. Preserve semantic resource ID, authority generation and execution-attempt/host-handle identity separately.

The current loop-of-loops bridge should retain its external authority boundary: recurrence/re-entry may preserve semantic lineage but a delayed effect must validate current permission/resource generation at commit/effect time.

Safe-Effect foreign-code/FFI closure receives a concrete Linux counterexample: a stale raw fd integer can target a newly rebound resource. Runtime mediation must hide or generation-seal host resource identity.

Persist/link semantic resource identity, grant/authority generation, process-local host binding and execution-attempt receipt as distinct identities; never reconstruct current authority from an old raw host handle.
Workspace admission/continuation/re-entry remains non-authoritative. This run adds an implementation constraint for delayed effects but no GWT mechanism/scientific change.
Graph activation/topology/resource references remain non-authoritative and must not refresh/mint current capability state.
Alternative/coupled resource candidates remain proposals until one exact current runtime binding passes authority validation.
No causal-emergence or consciousness inference follows from capability safety or host-handle identity results.
